# MatrixExtractColumns

Module: **core** · directory: `src/Programs` · binary: `src/Programs/MatrixExtractColumns`

Manual: [MatrixExtractColumns (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/MatrixExtractColumns.md)

```text
MatrixExtractColumns, version 0.01

Usage: MatrixExtractColumns [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-matrix : name of the file containing the binary matrix
    -o, --output-prefix : prefix to use of each extracted vector
    --first-column : index of the first column to extract (default value = 0)
    --nbr-columns : number of consecutive columns to extract (default value = 1)
    -c, --complex : indicate that the input matrix has complex coefficients

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
